eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input; window.__giro = () => { p.yaw = 0; p.pitch = 0; inp.dx = 100; inp.dy = 0; p.update(1 / 30); return +(-p.yaw).toFixed(5); }; window.__scope = (on) => { if (on !== w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; return { padrao: [p.sensitivity, w.scopeSensitivity], giroPor100px: __giro() }; })()
